# libwebp 1.6.0

Upstream: https://chromium.googlesource.com/webm/libwebp
Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/downloads.webmproject.org/releases/webp/libwebp-1.6.0.tar.gz
SHA-256: `e4ab7009bf0629fd11982d4c2aa83964cf244cffba7347ecd39019a9e38c4564`

Unmodified upstream source archive, including AUTHORS, COPYING and PATENTS.
CMake builds a static encoder/decoder only. The archive is checked before extraction;
configuration needs no network access. Windows consumers use matching static or DLL CRT builds.
